notes: A penalty shootout with fictional teams, ratings and standard scoring is Sports. The prompt explicitly scopes the build to penalty kicks only and the answer confirms just the penalty end is built, so there is no foul perimeter and no route through the space: this is range-directed, a single directed range with a discrete target at the end, and it takes the Target Sport preset rather than Field Sport. I added startpoint-play for the penalty spot, which the prompt names outright, and kept the stated stadium dressing — floodlit bowl, crowd, banners, benches and tunnel — as barrier-perimeter, spectator-bleachers, spectator-zone and npc-population, the tiered seating being the only elevation and so the tiered flag on P0. The scoreboard, floodlights and animated net are dressing no option row covers; they ride along in the image prompt rather than changing the shape or route.
